text.p: Traders said they expected the spread with Spain in the 10-year cash to remain slightly above five basis points on Wednesday after a session in which foreign markets set the tone for Portuguese paper.
Traders said that Spain would continue to lead the way.
Trade in the 10-year sector had been highly technical although the narrowing of the spread with the bunds to record lows below 120 basis points had attracted some profit-taking.
The short to medium end remains well-supported despite the fact that few expect the Bank of Portugal to cut rates Wednesday at the start of the new commercial bank reserve period.
Trade was likely to be quiet in the morning as investors awaited U.S. producer price data, dealers said.
Resistance for the December futures was put at 107.00, while support would come in at 106.25.
